plugins.name: wybe-connect
plugins.description: Feeds your Wybe node from Claude Code: a background distil turns your sessions into short work facts, redacted on your laptop before anything leaves it. The node never reads your machine. Sends only; the one thing that comes back is a task you gave your colleague for an open session, and one that needs your yes is shown to you first.
